name: Koetjes Blueberries
location: Intersection of Line & Bradley Road, WA
description: In Intersection of Line & Bradley Road, WA, Koetjes Blueberries raises Strawberries, Blueberries, Raspberries, Blackberries, and Apples on a small farm. The harvest is typically at its peak in summer. Visitors can find seasonal produce and farm-grown goods through summer and autumn. Check the website for current hours and availability.
